history.summary: The Shri Sai Baba Temple at Latur Rd, Vishal Nagar (East), Deep Jyoti Nagar, Latur, is a well-known Sai Baba devotional temple set in pleasant, tranquil, green surroundings with attractive architecture inside and out. Its Sai Baba idol is described as a replica of the Shirdi idol. Rated 4.6/5 across ~600 reviews, it ranks among Latur's most-visited Hindu shrines. IDENTITY FLAG: several Sai mandirs exist in Latur (e.g., Sai Baba Mandir at Shivaji Chowk); this entry documents the Deep Jyoti Nagar shrine, which is the best-reviewed and most documented of them. No web source gives its construction history; treat claims of antiquity with scepticism.

town_description: Latur is a major city in the Marathwada region of Maharashtra, known as an educational and trading hub with the distinctive circular Ganjgolai market at its centre. It lies about 2-3 hours south of Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar and is the administrative seat of Latur district.
